77. Primò (inquiunt Adversarii) si suppositum increatum superad-

l.i: dat substantiæ singulari, scilicet Divinitati, modum positivum etiam sup-
positum creatum superaddet substantiæ singulari creatæ modum positivum.

main_text.l: At ego dico contrarium potiùs sequi: Ideo enim suppositum in-
creatum superaddit Divinitati modum positivum, quia Divinitas præ-
cisè considerata sine modo subsistendi non est principium operatio-
num ad intra, nec distinguit unum suppositum divinum ab alio, &
ob id superadditur modus realis & positivus, per quem via persona
divina distinguitur ab alia, & constituitur sufficiens principium ope-
rationum ad intra; at in suppositis creatis nihil tale reperitur; nam
omnes naturæ substantiales creatæ secundùm se sunt realiter distinctæ
saltem numero in suppositis creatis; humanitas enim Petri verbi
gratiâ per se est realiter distincta saltem numero ab humanitate Pau-
li; & quælibet natura substantialis perfecta in supposito creato, est
sufficiens principium formale omnium actionum, & passionum quæ
tribuuntur supposito, imò & humanitas in Christo est sufficiens prin-
cipium totale & formale omnium actionum, & passionum humanar-
um quæ tribuuntur Christo.
78. Secundò (inquiunt adversarii) Verbum assumpsit naturam hu-

l.i: manam, non autem suppositalitatem humanam; alioquin essent duo sup-posita

main_text.l: aut duæ personæ in Christo, quod est hæreticum, & ideo post
in-carnationem Verbi, humanitas Christi non habet propriam subsistentiam
aut suppositalitatem, sed subsistit per subsistentiam Verbi quæ
supplet defectum suppositalitatis humanæ; non supplet autem d-
efectum negationis: Ergo suppositalitas creata superaddit substantiæ sin-

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are small italic and partly broken across lines. The note beside paragraph 79 at "Suppositalitas humana" and the one beside "non est quid" are clear; the third right-margin note beside "positivum" and "assumpta a verbo" is only partly legible and is given with an uncertain reading. The word "repentitur" in the printed text reads as "reperitur" in the scan, and the spacing in "additaliquid" is doubtful. The running head has been given with u/v normalisation. The first line starts with a fragment ("stantiæ") that is cut off at the left edge of the page.
